usedFor: Slack holds team conversations, and Wordware runs an app on them when “Run App” follows “New Mention”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Mention” in Slack, then “Run App” in Wordware
bestTemplate.why: When someone mentions you in a channel, a Wordware app runs on that message.

watchOut: “New Mention” is polling, so the Wordware app runs after a scheduled check, not on the mention.
